description: §4.12.2 (S443) — the remedy E-PROGRAM-NESTED-AUTH names: `auth="required"` on the TOP-LEVEL `<program>`, none on the nested one. The top-level `<program>`'s `auth=` is valid and the nested `<program>` carries no `auth=`, so the error does NOT fire.
rationale: §4.12.2 (S443): the error fires only for `auth=` on a nested `<program>`; `auth=` on the top-level `<program>` is the application-wide auth scope (§52.13).
